status: pre-execution engineering/learning pilot; not confirmatory RVL validation
split_selection: first 16 rows of each official train/test split, before outcome inspection; all retained
evaluation: one initial baseline and terminal greedy evaluation for each seed/arm; no promotion or evaluation-driven tuning; task identities fixed across all seeds
zero_update_control: repeat all baseline greedy decisions without training; require identical responses and correctness
primary_reporting: paired per-task greedy correctness difference, each seed/arm and aggregate; descriptive task-bootstrap; no claim of improvement from training reward or merely nonzero gradients
scope: single T4, <=0.5B model, 16 evaluation tasks, 4 updates; cannot establish frontier-scale learning, RVL failure boundaries or hiring readiness
failures: retain all attempts and partial outputs; no precision/model/task substitution without a new amended lock
